question.text: 'Satyam Cat III Long-Short AIF' has a target corpus of INR 400 crore. Under SEBI (AIF) Regulations, what is the minimum sponsor / manager continuing interest?

answer.text: INR 10 crore (lower of 5% of INR 400 cr = INR 20 cr or INR 10 cr)
INR 5 crore (lower of 2.5% of INR 400 cr = INR 10 cr or INR 5 cr)

explanation.text: The Logic: For Cat III AIFs, sponsor/manager continuing interest = LOWER of (5% of corpus, INR 10 crore). 5% of INR 400 cr = INR 20 cr; INR 10 cr is lower. Hence the requirement is INR 10 crore. The Trap: Option B applies the Cat I/II rule. Option C ignores the INR 10 cr cap. Option D fabricates a 2% number. Note: The 'lower of 5% / INR 10 crore' cap means Cat III sponsor commitment plateaus at INR 10 crore as corpus grows beyond INR 200 crore.
